site_description.default: A simple website generated by Jekyll.
site_description.description: A short description of the website.

site_baseurl.description: The baseurl of the site, e.g. /blog.

site_url.description: The url of the site, e.g. http://example.com.

author_name.description: The name of the site author.

author_email.description: The email address of the site author.

site_markdown.description: The name of the markdown processor (e.g., kramdown, redcarpet).

site_exclude.description: A list of files/directories to exclude from the build process.

site_safe.description: Whether to run Jekyll in safe mode, disabling custom plugins.

site_permalink.description: The style of permalinks (e.g., pretty, date, none).
